## Appearance

Anne is slender with a small pointed chin, freckles, and distinctive gray eyes that sparkle with emotion. She originally had bright red hair, which she wore in long braids as a young girl, though she once accidentally dyed it green. As she grew up, her hair settled into a rich, distinctive red tone.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P17](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0017), [v2 c1 P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v4 c1 P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000), [v4 c12 P19](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0019), [v4 c12 P20](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0020)_

## Personality

Anne possesses an exceptionally vivid, romantic imagination and a passionate temper that can flare dramatically when provoked. Highly sensitive, emotional, and prone to deep dramatics or feelings of despair, she is nonetheless warm-hearted, deeply loyal, and possesses a strong sense of duty and affection for her friends. Over time, her keen sense of humor develops alongside a thoughtful maturity, though she retains her poetic perspective on life.

## History

Born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, Anne was orphaned as a sickly infant when both her parents succumbed to fever. At eleven years old, she was mistakenly sent to Prince Edward Island to be adopted by Marilla and Matthew Cuthbert of Green Gables, who had originally requested a boy. Despite early mishaps, including broken slates, accidental liniment cake baking, and green dyed hair, Anne won over her adoptive family and the local community of Avonlea. She formed an enduring bond with her best friend Diana Barry and maintained a fierce academic rivalry with Gilbert Blythe. Anne attended Queen's Academy, winning the Avery Scholarship, but elected to remain at Green Gables to teach locally and care for Marilla. She later earned her B.A. at Redmond College in Kingsport, where she published her writing, made new friends like Philippa Gordon, and eventually reconciled her feelings for Gilbert Blythe. After marrying Gilbert, the couple settled into their 'house of dreams,' where they had a child named Little Jem and Anne formed a close friendship with her neighbor Leslie Moore.
